name: prompting-chef
description: Turn rough ideas, text, and draft prompts into production-ready prompts.

interface.longDescription: Prompting Chef analyzes rough text, ideas, and draft prompts, then engineers them into clear, precise, production-ready prompts.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the given text and convert this into a production-ready prompt.
Turn my rough idea into a production-ready prompt. Preserve my intent, resolve ambiguity, add the necessary context and constraints, and make the final prompt clear, precise, and ready to use.
